title: IDVerified Staking
tagline: Weather-based Insurance Smart Contract using Chainlink Price Feeds
description: This project demonstrates the use of Chainlink Price Feeds for a weather-based insurance smart contract. It demonstrates how insurance can be claimed based on weather conditions. One can claim the insurance if the weather is severe and to check the weather data we make use of chainlink price feeds. Sign Protocol to create attestations for users who are eligible to purchase insurance.
how_its_made:
Foundry, Chainlink Price Feeds.
One can claim the insurance if the weather is severe and to check the weather data we make use of chainlink price feeds. And Sign Protocol to create attestations for users who are eligible to purchase insurance.
1. Chainlink Price Feeds for temperature data
2. Sign Protocol for user identity verification
